newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. 17,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 54 loads or 1,800 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,600 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
The last established price was 67.00 on Thursday. Asking prices 69.00-70.00, bids have been 67.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
